items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year; scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim last week; Kubiak day-to-day, working tail off; Schefter realistic Week 2 chance
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer temporary TE1 if out
items.opportunity: If OUT, Michael Mayer elevated targets/routes

items.text: Ladd McConkey rib injury day-to-day per Harbaugh; status up in air for Week 2 vs Raiders, will monitor week.
items.why: Left early Week 1 chest/rib hit; imaging/tests, Harbaugh DTD
items.implication: Practice Wed-Fri key; high risk miss
items.opportunity: Tre' Harris/Quentin Johnston/Derius Davis upside if OUT

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious, day-to-day; MRI but would have played if playoff game. Coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Aggravated preseason hamstring late first half after 150 yds; not major
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or close; monitor
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, Bateman/Chris Moore/Rashod Bateman targets; Lane already longer-term wrist

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29/32 early RB opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, 6 targets 22% share, 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Handled nearly all early volume, high routes/targets as expected workhorse
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS in KC offense with Mahomes

items.text: Ashton Jeanty UPGRADES to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes/21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 2 TDs; every-down player.
items.why: Tied #1 Util Score, dominated LV backfield with improved YBC/YAC
items.implication: Start as RB1; bullish ROS with Kubiak scheme

items.text: Travis Etienne DOWNGRADES to low-end RB2: 58% snaps but 43% attempts/38% routes in 3-way committee (Kamara out); volume boosted by 86 plays.
items.why: Not clear lead despite Kamara absence; low route share
items.implication: Cautious if Kamara returns; committee risk
items.conflict: ETR noted Kamara status impacts Etienne proj

items.text: Bucky Irving UPGRADES mid-range RB2: 62% snaps, 58% routes, 53% rushes, short-yardage edge over Gainwell; 85 Util Score.
items.why: Clear lead vs Gainwell concerns; healthy usage

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65/70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected concentrated good offense; core four dominate
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore depth
items.opportunity: Massive snap/target/carry share locked for core

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid if result overstated: 8 carries (only GL RB carry), 21 routes > Gainwell 13, 7/7 targets; looked extremely healthy. Good CLE matchup next.
items.why: Out-routed Gainwell, sole GL work, healthy post-injury concerns
items.implication: Mid-RB2 with upside; hold over Gainwell
items.opportunity: Routes + GL role expansion vs CLE

items.text: Alvin Kamara not expected to play (knee); impacts Etienne projection. Love/Odunze expected; Nabers pending then active.
items.implication: Etienne more volume but still committee; reverse if Kamara IN later

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); only 2 targets 7% share but 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy 30). Needs volume.
items.why: Routes present but tiny aDOT/share; volume-dependent
items.implication: Monitor targets; boom if volume rises with Walker/Mahomes
items.opportunity: High route share foundation for targets

items.text: David Montgomery UPGRADES high-end RB2: 65% rushes, all inside-5, short-yardage lead in Texans committee; 79 Util.
items.why: Clear ground RB1 vs Marks; GL work despite script

items.text: Jeremiyah Love low-end short-term but borderline RB1 upside ROS: 44% snaps/37% att post-ankle, edge routes/TPRR; expect lead role.
items.why: Rookie Super Model #5; split with Allgeier but progressive

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks; even after Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used 3rd-stringer Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite backfield injury
